checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is recognizably the woman in the portrait
must.why: Same curly hair, sweater, park background; face stays consistent, only slightly more expressive.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: Audio not transcribed; the agent itself warned that words may be off.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth open in different shapes across frames, closing to a smile at the end; sync itself can't be verified.

must.item: One square 8-second video with audible friendly female English speech
must.why: Square frames, 8 s, audio has a peak of -0.4 dB; the voice's gender and language can't be verified.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text, which is correct because captions were not wanted. The spoken words could not be checked.

faults.what: Spoken wording is unverified; the model may have altered or added words.
Expression is exaggerated and the face is slightly wider or reshaped in the talking frames, but the identity is preserved.

summary: The clip is a square 8-second video of the same curly-haired woman, with natural talking motion, no captions and audible sound; the spoken script could not be checked.
